code:
At deposit: 100 ETH + 200,000 USDC @ 2,000/ETH = 400,000
ETH price doubles to 4,000. Pool rebalances (x*y=k):
  New reserves: 70.71 ETH + 282,842.70 USDC = 565,685.40

HODL alternative: 100*4,000 + 200,000 = 600,000

Impermanent loss: 565,685.40 - 600,000 = -34,314.60 (-5.72%)
caption: Before counting any trading fees earned along the way.
